snippet.title: When Tough Lessons Come From the Court 👇
snippet.description:
When Tough Lessons Come From the Court 👇

A spirited basketball game sparks more than friendly rivalry.

One woman’s offhand joke crosses a line, stirring tension.

The opposing team questions respect, tolerance, and what it truly means to accept differences.

Amid laughter and competition, a deeper conversation unfolds about values and judgment.

It’s not just about winning the game.

It’s about how we treat one another when we’re under pressure.

👉 True tolerance doesn’t just mean putting up with what we dislike—it means choosing respect when it’s hard.

👉 Words spoken lightly can carry weight and impact people's feelings deeply.

👉 Teaching kindness and respect starts with us, especially when bridging different views or generations.

The uncomfortable truth?

We often mistake tolerance for weakness or compromise, missing that it’s a conscious act of respect.

And in moments of conflict, we reveal our true character—whether we build bridges or walls.

So the real question is:

How do you respond when someone challenges your values, and what does that say about your own respect for others? 👇💬

⚖️ നിയമം എല്ലാവർക്കും ഒരുപോലെ ബാധകമാകണം!

🔥 പഴയ കാലമല്ല… പുതിയ കാലമാണ്!

ഈ സംഭവത്തിൽ നിങ്ങൾ ആരുടെ ഭാഗത്താണ്? നിങ്ങളുടെ അഭിപ്രായം കമന്റ് ചെയ്യൂ.

Lily has a shiny magic wand with a big star. "Let me try a spell!" she says. She waves the wand, and sparkles fly everywhere! Poof! Henry is wearing a pink princess dress and a golden crown! • wrong (adj.) = not right
• princess (n.) = a girl in a royal family
• crown (n.) = a golden hat for a king or queen
• dress (n.) = a piece of clothing for a girl or woman
• turn into (phrasal v.) = to change into something else
• sparkle (v.) = to shine with little lights
• laugh (v.) = to make a happy sound when something is funny

snippet.title: Did you notice these editing mistakes in Marvel movies? #marvel #mcu #movie #foryou #usa
snippet.description:
In *Spider-Man: Homecoming*, Peter Parker's introduction in his first solo movie

is him filming a video diary, talking about his experience in *Captain America: Civil War*.

However, fans quickly noticed that although the video only showed a few clips from that legendary airport battle,

there were several obvious mismatches.

First, after Tony called Spider-Man over,

he said that line—

the one we all remember from the *Civil War* trailer.

Except Peter didn't say it that way.

He rambled for a while before finally saying that line.

In *Iron Man*, when Tony was testing the Mark 2,

there was nothing around the vehicle on the far left.

But the next second, when he transformed, a motorcycle suddenly appeared in front of the car.

Also in *Infinity War*, Iron Man and Pepper Potts were discussing names for their future child.

snippet.title: November 19, 2026
snippet.description:
Valve keepers are some of the smallest but most important components in an engine’s valvetrain. Also called valve locks or collets, these two tapered metal pieces secure the valve spring retainer to the valve stem during cylinder head assembly.

During installation, a valve spring compressor creates clearance around the valve stem so the keepers can be positioned in their retaining groove. As the spring compressor is released, the valve spring pushes the retainer against the tapered keepers, capturing them securely around the valve stem. This locking arrangement allows the valve spring assembly to remain secured during engine operation.

Incorrectly seated or incompatible valve keepers can lead to serious valvetrain damage, including a dropped valve and piston contact. That’s why proper keeper engagement and retainer seating are essential during professional engine rebuilding.

snippet.description:
Yıldız ve Serhat'ın mutlu sonu. HERKES İÇİN MUTLU SON
Halef: Köklerin Çağrısı 43. bölüm (final) sahnelerini izlemek için tıklayın: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLCntOhkQ9g_Q&si=ecRDyplDWdGafmZl

Yıldız’ın vurulmasıyla Serhat için endişeli bir bekleyiş başlar. Adeta çılgına dönen Nurgül ise durmaya niyetli değildir. Akif’le yeniden iş birliği yaparak Yıldız ve Serhat’ı ortadan kaldırmak için son ve ölümcül  hamlesini yapmak üzere harekete geçer.

Diğer yandan Ziyan’ın vurulması, Kordağlı Konağı’nda dengeleri değiştirir. Babahan’ın halefi olan Aşır, şimdi Kordağlı aşiretinin de başına geçmek zorundadır.

Taşkesen tarafında ise Rami, Sado için bir tehlike haline gelmiştir ve artık ortadan kaldırılması gereken bir hedeftir. Ancak Sado’nun planının farkında olan Rami, ölümcül hamlesini yapar.   

Pastaya konulan zehirle, başta Yıldız olmak üzere Serhat’ın değer verdiği her şey elinden kayıp gitmiştir. Bu durum, hem Urfa hem de Serhat için yepyeni bir dönemin habercisidir. Bu yeni dönemde Serhat’ın karşısında, yeni bir Yıldız vardır. 

Aşkı uğruna kimi zaman aşiretinden, kimi zaman ailesinden vazgeçen Serhat’ın önünde bu kez çok daha büyük engeller durmaktadır. Yıldız’a yeniden kavuşabilmesi için her zamankinden daha fazla fedakârlık yapması, daha büyük bir mücadele vermesi ve belki de onu her zamankinden daha çok sevmesi gerekmektedir. 

Zira bu kez Serhat’ın Yıldız’a kavuşmasının önündeki en büyük engel, Yıldız’ın ta kendisidir.
